research_questions.question: Has 'rsi 1m' deteriorated structurally?
research_questions.mechanism: the mean net result per trade dropped (Page-Hinkley alarm)
evidence: first half -0.355% vs second half -0.226% per trade over 117 trades
contradicting: a few large losses can trigger the alarm
research_questions.falsification: the decline does not persist in the next 30 trades of this type
research_questions.expected_benefit: earlier suspension of a failing strategy type
research_questions.experiment: revalidate on historical replay and forward shadow

research_questions.question: Would abstaining when a mandatory uncertainty gate fails improve decisions?
research_questions.mechanism: trades taken without positive expected edge, fresh/complete data or familiar conditions have no reason to win
evidence: 660 of 667 entries failed at least one gate
contradicting: the expected-edge estimate is itself uncertain; abstaining also means trading less
alternatives: any reduction in trading lowers costs whatever the selection
research_questions.falsification: H-ABSTAIN falsified, or the uncertainty-aware variant does not beat a random-abstention control with the same trade count
research_questions.expected_benefit: fewer weak trades, lower cost drag
research_questions.experiment: variant B vs incumbent vs random-abstention control (history replay + forward shadow)
